_howto: Every src/thumb resolves RELATIVE TO THIS FILE'S URL. Put this file in any public repo, host media next to it, and RAPP Vision streams it straight off raw.githubusercontent / Pages. Absolute https:// URLs work too, so media may live in a different repo entirely.
